text:
sam: Customer asked for a compact preflight + explicit rollback SLA before signing. keep this lean.

mina: Key asks: single-page human report, tiny manifest (no IPs), HMAC of installer, and opt-in consent line.

oliver: Preflight checks (suggested): TCP egress 443/50051, TLS chain check, relay-only handshake, NAT detection, BGP test (opt-in). Output: PASS/WARN/FAIL + one-line remediation.

sam: Manifest fields limited to: installer_hmac, agent_semver, kernel_major, bgp_optin (true/false), outbound_443 (PASS/FAIL), telemetry_opt_in (true/false). no host identifiers.

legal: consent wording to include: "I consent to share anonymized install manifest with Redwood for support." checkbox + UTC timestamp. require manifest HMAC signed by CI.

mina: Upgrade lanes: fast (automated, staged, relay fallback) MTTR <=15m; cautious (manual) MTTR <=60m. Max 2 rolling restarts on minor patches.

oliver: Rollback triggers: >3% node failures or control-plane error spike >5% in 5m. Auto-halt + snapshot rollback. We'll validate in lab.

sam: Next steps: oliver PoC preflight binary in 48h; mina mock console card + download in 1w; legal to provide clause. We'll meet next Tues with PoC.

sec-bot: NOTE: created task ONRAMP-5001 preflight PoC queued.
